newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Electrolux locates freezer R&D to Hungary.
newsitem.headline: Electrolux locates freezer R&D to Hungary.

text.p: Swedish household appliance group Electrolux AB said on Friday it will locate all research and development (R&D) regarding freezers to Hungary.
The company said it will use Hungarian subcontractors to supply part of the group's European production network.
"Hungary offers good infrastructure, a well educated work force and a competitive cost situation," Electrolux's chief executive Leif Johansson said in a statement.
"So far we have been very happy with our Hungarian investments."
Since Electrolux took over the Hungarian white goods appliance maker Lehel in 1991, the company has grown to become one of Hungary's three largest manufacturing groups.
Electrolux has an annual turnover of about 1.4 billion crowns in Hungary, including exports, and has somewhat more than five percent of the country's manufacturing exports, it said.
